about_the_game:
A great journey doesn’t always begin with a small step, but sometimes with a ridiculous fall. Into a cauldron, for example. And here you are: in the witch's cottage, wearing an oversized hat, with an old cauldron nearby, waiting for its new mistress.
Before you lies a vast, unfamiliar world—and you'll come to know it through the stories of its visitors. All sorts of stories!

Join young witch Rena and dive into a world of passion, witchcraft, intrigue, love, and… hot content.

❤ - Vivid characters, animated scenes, and full voice acting won't leave you indifferent!

❤ - And in the full version, there will be even more—bigger, brighter, hotter. Our team will make sure you won't walk away disappointed.
Step into the role of a young witch, Rena, who finds herself in an extraordinary world. There are no gods or religions here, but plenty of powerful entities and mysterious cults. The skies are filled with airships, the roads are raced by steam-powered carriages, but you can easily encounter wizards, demons, fascinating races, and visitors from other worlds.

Visitors will come to you for advice or to buy potions to solve their problems. But will you choose to help them? After all, you can deceive or persuade your guests, steer them toward the light or the dark (depending on what benefits you the most), force them into servitude, or win them over with kindness. No one will judge you—this is your story! And not every healing potion will serve a noble purpose, nor will a tangle of tentacles always turn your guest into a true monster.

Seduce or leave them yearning, make influential friends and get rid of enemies, help heroes or villains! The game remembers all your actions, and sooner or later, they will impact the narrative branches. Power and glory, fear and bravery, honor and deceit—these are mere words to someone who has donned a witch's hat and stood by the cauldron. Your craft unlocks countless possibilities; you just have to choose the path Rena will take.
❤ - Play as a witch however you want: be kind and help those in need, or succumb to temptation and unleash your darkest and wickedest fantasies.
❤ - Customize Rena, change her appearance to suit your taste.
❤ - Manage resources wisely—even a wilted bundle of herbs could save a life, and a rat tail could shatter grand plans.
❤ - Master the art of brewing potions using secret recipes while carefully controlling cauldron temperature, steam color, and ingredient order.

❤ - Explore a nonlinear, branching narrative with multiple plotlines.
❤ - Meet a diverse cast of characters, uncover their unique stories, and decide their fates.
❤ - Modify the appearances of Rena and her guests with special potions.

❤ - Erotic scenes visually reflect the appearances you've chosen for Rena and other characters.

content_descriptors.notes:
The game contains sexual content with various fetishes. All characters are of legal age. Scenes of nudity and explicit conversations without offensive language or profanity may appear in the game.
Some players may find the content offensive.
The game includes sexual scenes unlocked through quest progression, all of which are story-driven. These include: classic sex, oral encounters, furry content, tentacle scenes, and futanari.
There are no scenes of physical cruelty or violence.
